previous_statement: Distinguish u_pol and u_grp. By 1.7.4, (u_pol,h_pol) is the unique inverse of the explicit typed map Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H. By 1.7.5 and 1.7.5.3, the group-laws external supplies its conclusions for u_grp but supplies neither a companion h nor either inverse identity for this explicit Pi_delta. Uniqueness can compare two candidates only after both are shown to be inverses of the same map with the same source and target; that antecedent is absent here. Therefore u_grp=u_pol cannot be inferred, and the group-law conclusions cannot be transported to the root-bound u_pol from the registered inputs.
new_statement: The pointwise criterion from 1.7.5.2 is the correct minimum needed for synchronization; it does not require two global inverses. Here the stronger registered external lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality applies to the polar datum whose first inverse component is the u_delta used by lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws and to the explicit datum supplied by 1.7.4. Both data use the same delta and the same map Pi_delta(U,H)=U bold-dot H on calU x B_delta^{calH}(J), so their images coincide with S_delta and coherence gives u_grp=u_pol throughout S_delta. Consequently the group-law formulas and conclusions transfer to the root-bound inverse component.
